# The ngspice-vacask cell's failing steps (`tests/test_pair.rs`): `<deck> <step 1..6> <class> <proof>`,
# compared by (deck, step) both ways, class included (a refusal's class names its features). A
# line goes the day its step passes.
# Proofs: `ruling=<id>` a ruling or amendment that settles the cause and says when it goes;
# `pass=<name>` the pass rewrite/DIALECT-VACASK.md §6.1 plans for the feature refused (not
# registered on the trunk); `finding=<id>` a pair finding sent to the lead.
# Recorded on pair-test after step2-vacask 1a5ea541 (R64a) and step2-passes 59d0ab4c (A35's
# naming rules): every deck reaches the simulators again; F1 is gone (dc_sweep, diode, mosfet
# pass all six).
